implementerProof.how: Review 5706920646's seven findings were each driven at this head with a control of my own, not read from the diff. (1) The golang binding: I reproduced the reviewer's own case on the real tree — a `golang:1.28.0-alpine` row added and heldportwrapper/Dockerfile:16's FROM moved onto it while worker.Dockerfile keeps `ARG GO_VERSION=1.27.1` — and the tree mode exits 1 naming the file, the row, both versions and the two-commit order. The bump's second commit is the green half: with the ARG at 1.28.0 and all three golang FROMs (worker.Dockerfile, packages/envoy/docker/Dockerfile, heldportwrapper/Dockerfile) on the new row, the tree mode passes with 13 rows. Both mutations reverted, `jj status` clean. (2) The row's label against its bytes: I drove .github/scripts/mirror-ci-images.sh itself from a fixture with a stub `crane` first on PATH, which is the one way to reach the copy without a registry. A row labelled `oven/bun:1.4.5` carrying the 1.4.4 digest, with the stub resolving that tag to another digest, fails before any copy: `docker.io/oven/bun:1.4.5 is sha256:deadbeef…, and this row's digest is sha256:1d22548f…. The row's label and its bytes disagree, and every other gate reads the label`. With the stub resolving the tag to the row's digest the same run prints `label … is …, this row's digest`, copies `docker.io/oven/bun:1.4.5@sha256:1d22548f…` (the tag kept before the `@`, which crane's name.NewDigest drops) and ends `0 row(s) already in the package, 1 copied`. A second run over the held row, with the upstream tag now resolving elsewhere, prints `held …` and passes, which is the scoping the implementer argued for: a floating tag never fails a row that was copied honestly. (3) The restart: `newRuntime()` at merged_root_waits_live_test.go:130 sets `InPod`, and both the construction (:114) and `restart()` (:231) call it, so no boot of that proof relaunches a claim with host workspaces; the two sibling proofs build their runtime once and declare no `restart()` at all, so they are rightly untouched. CI's own command, `cd packages/daemon && go vet -tags e2e ./...`, exits 0 with no output. (4) The four small fixes: the tag rule now reads the whole string — a tag `zzz-bb05d66d`, whose last eight characters are right, is refused with `tag zzz-bb05d66d is not seaweedfs-3.97-bb05d66d, the tag this row's upstream and digest give it`; the hand-written reference split is gone from the copy (the source is built in the script's own python as `<upstream without its digest>@<row digest>`, which my C2 control shows verbatim in the copy line); `reads_version` and its case are gone from check-bun-version.sh, whose harness is 119 where it was 120; and setup-bun/action.yml now names one `ARG BUN_VERSION`, worker.Dockerfile's, and the two-commit bump, with no file of the tree still saying `two Dockerfile`. Every harness is green at this head: check-ci-images 96 (89 before), mirror-ci-images 30 (25 before), check-bun-version 119, select-e2e-proofs 94, ci-ok 40, and the tree mode passes with 12 rows and 35 references.
